ok I'm too mad to sleep so here we go. some sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling my switchblade moth. MY moth. the one off my flash sheet. they've got it listed as "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal", $6.50 or 3 for $15.

for anybody who doesnt know, I drew that moth for the sept 13 flash day. posted the sheet aug 30, scroll back and look, its still up. drew the whole thing at my kitchen table. it went in the first hour and that was supposed to be the end of it.

a friend sent me the listing tonight and it is not "similar." it is not "inspired by." its a straight scan of my linework. same crack in the blade. same wing pattern. they didnt even FLIP it. like at least pretend??

so I messaged them. I was nice about it. told them its my design, I have the original drawing and the dated post, please take it down. what I got back was "Love your work!" and then a bunch of stuff about how their artists make original designs, moths are a common motif, and if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. have a great day. HAVE A GREAT DAY.

yeah moths are a common motif. a moth holding a switchblade with a crack in the exact spot where I put it is not a common motif, thats my drawing.

and this is what really got me. the person who has this tattoo messaged me tonight asking if I was the one selling stickers of it. NO. absolutely not. I never would. if thats you reading this, it wasnt me, I didnt know about it till tonight, and I'm just as mad as you are.

flash is sold ONE time to ONE person. thats the whole deal. thats what you're paying for when you pick something off a sheet. the client paid for a one of one, and now some sticker place is selling it 3 for $15 to slap on water bottles.

I literally posted last month about how I wont copy another artists work off pinterest because its the one rule in this industry everybody agrees on. apparently not everybody.

and these places know exactly what they're doing. they know tattoo artists and small shops dont have lawyer money. thats the whole business model. lift it off somebodys page, and when they complain, say love your work and point them at a form.

so heres what I'm asking. dont buy from StickerBurrow Co. go find the Knife Moth Vinyl Decal listing and report it as stolen art. share this if you want. and if you already bought one I'm not mad at you, you didnt know, just know where it came from.

ok. rant over. gonna go stare at the ceiling
